title: Annotatio IV §.XVII: Albigenses rise by Scripture and Fathers — crusade diverted; pure doctrine scattered
pass_a_gloss: But on the contrary (Morneus continues) in the same age in Dauphiné, the Narbonese, Occitan and Aquitanian Province, the Albigenses are both gravely offended by this Pontifical doctrine and rise strongly against it, nonetheless resolved to believe and teach and live according to the norm of Holy Scripture and the use of the more ancient Fathers. The Pontiff therefore more eager to overthrow than to convert sends Dominic in appearance to preach, but in truth Leopold Duke of Austria and Simon Count of Montfort with huge forces to oppress by violence: the money collected against the Turks — they called it the Crusade — turned without sacrilege against them; further he lays those regions waste with fire and iron, meanwhile achieving nothing else than that, scattered through all Europe — through Italy, Germany, Bohemia, England, the inmost parts of Gaul — they disperse the purer doctrine he was busy extinguishing.
pass_b_english: Same age: Albigenses in Dauphiné, Narbonne, Occitania, Aquitaine are offended and rise against the pontifical doctrine by Scripture and the older Fathers’ use.
Innocent, keener to overthrow than convert, sends Dominic for show but Montfort and Leopold with armies — crusade money turned on them; fire and iron only scatter the purer doctrine across Europe.
source_text: At è contra (pergit Morneus) eâdem ætate in Delphinatu, Provincia Narbonensi, Occitana & Aquitana, Albigenses, & graviter hâc Pontificiâ doctrinâ offenduntur, & fortiter in eam insurgunt, secundum S. Scripturæ normam & antiquiorum Patrum usum, & credere, & docere, & vivere nihilominus rati. Pontifex itaque evertendorum quam convertendorum studiosior, Dominicum in speciem concionaturum mittit, at re vera, Leopoldum Ducem Austriæ & Simonem Comitem de Monteforti, cum ingentibus copiis vi oppressuros: pecuniam in Turcas collectam, Cruciatam vocabant, non sine sacrilegio interversam, in eos convertit; regiones porrò illas igne & ferrô vastat, nil aliud interim consecutus, quam ut totâ Europa sparsi, per Italiam, Germaniam, Bohemiam, Angliam, intima Galliæ, puriorem doctrinam, quam extinguere curabat, dispergerent.
